People who understand the business and make verification judgments retain opportunity.
risks: Workflow replacement: AI automates preprocessing and classification
Average income: slow growth at public institutions
Demanding fieldwork: weather and terrain affect outdoor operations
Industry fluctuation: project work depends on public funding and budgets
Skill iteration: failure to learn new tools quickly causes obsolescence

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can automatically classify imagery, but remote sensing technicians still sign off on whether results can support farming decisions, insurance claims, and disaster-loss estimates.

responsibilities: Process imagery and extract information
Conduct field verification and sample collection
Prepare thematic maps and results reports
Maintain data and coordinate business requirements
skills: Remote sensing image processing and correction

career_risk_cards.callout: 遥感技术员最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「停留在软件操作层」——AI 拿走的正是重复流程，往验证和业务走才有护城河。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「数据处理流程的快速标准化」——预处理和分类正被云平台和 AI 模型接管，只会跑固定流程的技术员会被压缩，能懂业务、会做验证判断的人才有空间。
risks: 流程替代：预处理与分类被 AI 自动化
收入一般：事业单位涨幅慢
野外辛苦：外业受天气地形影响
行业波动：项目制受财政与预算影响
技能迭代：不学新工具迅速落后

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能自动把影像分类跑完，但「这份结果能不能拿去种地决策、报保险、定灾损」，最后签字负责的还是遥感技术员。

responsibilities: 处理遥感影像并提取信息
开展野外验证与样本采集
编制专题图与成果报告
维护数据并对接业务需求

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but emotional demands + night shifts. Advisors often mediate disputes and answer emergency calls, while systems absorb room assignment tasks.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk is emotional labor + nighttime responsibility. Advisors regularly handle conflicts and emergencies on irregular schedules. Room assignment and maintenance systems absorb some administrative work, but cannot replace interpersonal support.
risks: High emotional labor
Nighttime responsibility and emergencies
Room assignments absorbed by systems
High pressure from conflict management
Irregular schedules

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart systems become, advisors still observe when two roommates are incompatible and who seems unwell tonight, mediate with their words, and remain emotionally present. People cannot be fully removed from residence halls.

responsibilities: Manage occupancy and order
Mediate conflicts
Safety assurance
Organize activities

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「情绪 + 夜班」——常调解接突发，排宿还被系统吃。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「情绪劳动 + 夜间责任」——常处理冲突与突发，作息不规律；同时排宿报修系统吃掉部分事务，但人际支持难替代。
risks: 情绪劳动重
夜间责任与突发
排宿被系统吃
冲突处理压力大
作息不规律

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，那两个室友合不来、谁今晚状态不对，最后还是顾问的眼去观察、嘴去调解、心去守——宿舍这头，人撤不干净。

responsibilities: 管理入住秩序
调解冲突
保障安全
组织活动

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk stays manageable as long as you do not overstep your scope and keep learning. The moat for Supply Chain Managers lies in execution and judgment, not repetitive labor.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk comes from high-risk exposure and unclear accountability, not AI. People remain responsible for Supply Chain Managers judgments and final review; AI handles only structured tasks.
risks: Pressure from accountability and compliance boundaries in supply chain management.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.
Communication overhead in cross-role collaboration.

page.contract_project_risk_block: Split high risk into what you can learn and what you can control: methods are learnable, process and compliance are controllable.

responsibilities: Develop and execute supply chain work plans.
Take responsibility for the quality and risks of supply chain outputs.
Coordinate resources and drive supply chain project delivery.
Review and optimize supply chain processes and methods.

skills.说明: Use AI and professional software well

career_path_block.可控: 用 AI 提效、转向判断

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险可控的前提是「不越责任边界 + 持续补课」——供应链经理的护城河在执行与判断，不在重复劳动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「高风险敞口 + 责任边界」——供应链经理的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Supply Chain Managers领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把高风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

responsibilities: 制定与执行Supply Chain Managers相关的工作方案。
对Supply Chain Managers产出质量与风险负责。
协调资源、推动Supply Chain Managers项目交付。
复盘优化Supply Chain Managers流程与方法。

career_path_block.说明: A required entry stage with low pay
Software replaces part of the work
Hybrid skills with high bargaining power

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but a break in process expertise. Clinging to old craftsmanship without learning new software is the true route to obsolescence.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI, but loss of process expertise. As senior craftspeople retire, fewer people can independently design processes for complete dies. Young workers learn CNC and programming, but hybrid talent who truly understand materials, heat treatment, assembly, and debugging is becoming scarce.
risks: CNC and automation reduce single-machine operator roles
Workshop dust and noise create occupational health risks
Die cycles closely follow manufacturing conditions
Long apprenticeships discourage young entrants
A gap remains with foreign capabilities in complex high-end dies

page.contract_project_risk_block: Contracts vary widely in die making, so clarify piece-rate and overtime pay in advance. Before moving into CNC programming, confirm whether the employer provides training to avoid paying for skills that the job will not use.

responsibilities: Develop and execute die machining processes
Complete die assembly, heat treatment, and fitting
Organize tryouts and resolve product defects
Maintain equipment, measuring instruments, and quality records
skills: Die drawing interpretation and process planning
Tryout defect diagnosis and die repair

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「工艺断层」——只守着老手艺不学新软件，才是真的会被淘汰。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大风险不是 AI 而是「工艺空心化」——老师傅退休后，能独立完成整套模具工艺设计的人越来越少；数控和编程岗年轻人愿意学，但真正懂材料、懂热处理、懂装配调试的复合型人才在断层。
risks: 单一机床操作岗位被数控与自动化压缩
车间粉尘噪声带来职业健康风险
模具周期与制造业景气度强相关
学徒周期长，年轻人入行意愿低
高端复杂模能力与国外仍有差距

page.contract_project_risk_block: 模具行业合同差异大，计件与加班费要提前谈清；转数控编程岗前确认企业是否提供培训，避免自费学完无用武之地。

responsibilities: 制定模具加工工艺并执行加工
完成模具装配、热处理与研配
组织试模并解决产品缺陷
维护设备量具与质量记录
skills: 车铣磨与 EDM 加工
